items.name: Nadi Shodhana
items.description: Slow breathing through one nostril at a time; calms the mind and balances the nervous system.
items.avoidIf: Breathe gently; never strain or hold the breath without a teacher.

items.name: Bhramari
items.description: Humming on the out-breath; quietens the mind, eases anxiety and helps sleep.
items.avoidIf: Avoid lying down; stop if dizzy.

items.name: Ujjayi
items.description: Slow breathing with a soft throat sound; said to remove phlegm from the throat and strengthen digestion.
items.avoidIf: Avoid breath-holding in heart disease and high blood pressure.

items.name: Shitali and Sheetkari
items.description: Breathing in through a rolled tongue or the teeth; cools the body, eases acidity, thirst and Pitta.
items.avoidIf: Avoid in cold, cough, asthma and low blood pressure.

items.name: Kapalabhati
items.description: Short forceful out-breaths; clears Kapha and phlegm, stimulates digestion.
items.avoidIf: Avoid in pregnancy, high blood pressure, heart disease, epilepsy, hernia, recent surgery and during periods.

items.name: Bhastrika
items.description: Forceful in and out breaths; warms the body and clears Kapha.
items.avoidIf: Same cautions as Kapalabhati; avoid in Pitta conditions.

items.name: Jala Neti
items.description: Rinsing the nose with lukewarm salt water; clears sinuses and allergies.
items.avoidIf: Use boiled or sterile water only (tap water has caused rare fatal infections). Avoid with nosebleeds or ear infection.

items.name: Shavasana
items.description: Lying still with full relaxation; removes fatigue and calms the mind.
items.avoidIf: Suitable for almost everyone.

items.name: Yoga Nidra
items.description: Body scan and guided relaxation; helps sleep, stress and blood pressure.
items.source: Modern practice built on Tantric pratyahara
items.avoidIf: Suitable for almost everyone.

items.name: Paschimottanasana
items.description: Stretches the back of the body; HYP says it kindles digestive fire and slims the abdomen.
items.avoidIf: Avoid with acute back pain, slipped disc and in pregnancy.

items.name: Ardha Matsyendrasana
items.description: Seated twist; HYP says it increases appetite and helps digestion.
items.avoidIf: Avoid with disc problems, recent abdominal surgery and in pregnancy.

items.name: Bhujangasana
items.description: Gentle backbend lying on the front; strengthens the back and stimulates digestion.
items.avoidIf: Avoid in pregnancy, hernia and acute back injury.

items.name: Shalabhasana
items.description: Lying on the front, lifting the legs; strengthens the low back.
items.avoidIf: Avoid with heart disease and high blood pressure.

items.name: Vajrasana
items.description: Sitting on the heels; the one pose advised after meals, for digestion and gas.
items.avoidIf: Avoid with knee injury or severe arthritis of the knee.

items.name: Pavanamuktasana
items.description: Knees hugged to the chest; relieves gas, bloating and constipation.
items.avoidIf: Avoid after abdominal surgery and in pregnancy.

items.name: Tadasana
items.description: Standing tall and stretching up; posture, balance and circulation.
items.avoidIf: Suitable for most people.

items.name: Sukshma Vyayama
items.description: Slow rotations of neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, knees and ankles; keeps joints mobile.
items.source: Common Yoga Protocol, Ministry of Ayush
items.avoidIf: Move within a pain-free range only.

items.name: Setu Bandhasana
items.description: Lifting the hips from lying on the back; strengthens the back, hips and pelvic floor.
items.avoidIf: Avoid with neck injury.

items.name: Makarasana
items.description: Resting on the front with relaxed back muscles; eases back pain and breathing.
items.avoidIf: Suitable for most people.

items.name: Surya Namaskara
items.description: A flowing series of 12 postures; overall fitness, weight and metabolism.
items.avoidIf: Avoid in pregnancy, high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia and back injury; go slowly.

items.name: Mandukasana
items.description: Kneeling forward bend pressing fists into the abdomen; traditionally used for digestion and diabetes.
items.avoidIf: Avoid after abdominal surgery, with ulcers and knee problems.

items.name: Viparita Karani (legs up the wall)
items.description: Legs resting up a wall; venous drainage, calm.
items.avoidIf: Avoid during periods, with glaucoma, high blood pressure and neck problems.

items.name: Dhyana
items.description: Sitting still and attending to the breath or a mantra; stress, mood and focus.
items.avoidIf: If meditation brings up distress, pause and seek guidance.

items.name: Trataka
items.description: Gazing at a candle flame without blinking, then closing the eyes; HYP says it benefits the eyes.
items.avoidIf: Avoid in glaucoma, epilepsy and eye infection.

items.name: Simhasana
items.description: Kneeling, mouth open, tongue out, exhaling with a roar; throat, voice and mouth.
items.avoidIf: Suitable for most people.

items.name: Gentle chair yoga
items.description: Seated stretches and breathing for people with limited mobility.
items.avoidIf: Work only with a therapist after stroke or serious illness.
